tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Sound black, the wall. Main ground for the public site and every studio screen (artist portal, admin, bar till, gamer portal). Text on it: paper (18.2:1), yellow (11.6:1), muted (12.2:1). Also the text colour on yellow (11.6:1) and paper (18.2:1), the 2px edge of fields on paper, and the focus ring on yellow. Never pure black.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Poster yellow, the lead colour. Headline blocks, the main button (one per screen, black text 11.6:1), money and amounts on the till, text links and the focus ring on black (11.6:1), the 4px line under the site header, grille holes. Text on it is always black. Never text on paper (1.6:1).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Flame red, the second block. Artist pages, release tags, the Lounge block and the Lounge button, the thick bar under every section title, the focus ring on paper (5.0:1), error text on paper (5.0:1). Text on it: paper (5.0:1); black, yellow or muted only at 24px and up (3.6, 3.2, 3.4:1). As text on black it is 3.6:1, so only 24px and up. Brighter than the logo's own red on purpose.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The reading ground for long text and forms (About, biographies, the form block), and the main text colour on black (18.2:1), red (5.0:1) and green (6.0:1). The white of three-tone photos. Fill of form fields. Focus ring on red (5.0:1).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Inner green, small doses only: open, live, paid, done. A chip with paper text (6.0:1), or text on paper (6.0:1). Never a block, a page ground or a photo tone. As text on black it fails (3.0:1). Never beside equal red and yellow blocks (the flag look).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text on black (12.2:1), panel (11.7:1) and raised: intros, table headings, meta lines, the footer. On red only at 24px and up (3.4:1). Not for paper or yellow grounds.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers on black and panel: table rows, studio card edges, Lounge list rules. Decoration only (1.6:1 on black), never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: A lifted studio panel on black, such as the bar till's open-tabs box. Same text rules as black (paper 17.4:1, yellow 11.1:1, muted 11.7:1). Not a public-site block.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The fourth colour in a row of roster tiles, after yellow, red and paper, so the row does not vanish into the black wall. Paper text on it 14.4:1, yellow 9.2:1.

tokens.name: lens
tokens.usage: Black at 50%: the dark see-through circle behind the light logo on a photo. The only circle allowed behind the logo; never solid.

tokens.name: logo-red
tokens.usage: The logo's own oxblood (outer flame and lettering of the original files). Reference only: never recolour the logo to the palette, and never use this colour for text or blocks. The original logo reads 5.0:1 on yellow and 7.9:1 on paper, but only 2.3:1 on black and 1.6:1 on red.

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.usage: The logo's own olive inner flame in the original files. Reference only: never used for text, blocks or status (that is green).

families.poster: "Big Shoulders Display", Oswald, Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: Home hero, Lounge hero and social posts only. Uppercase. Five words or fewer, one word per line where it fits; longer text drops to title. Fluid: clamp(56px, 9vw, 112px); covers and posters may run to 150px. Black on yellow, paper or yellow on black, paper on red.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page and section openers, always with the short thick red bar under it. Uppercase. Five words or fewer; longer drops to title. clamp(36px, 7vw, 64px).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Uppercase. Names, card titles, empty-state titles, and any poster or headline text longer than five words.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase. Small titles: Lounge list rows, studio panel heads, tab names on the till. The smallest poster size; it is the floor for red on black or black on red (3.6:1).

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Big counts and money totals in studio screens and stat tiles. Even-width figures (tabular-nums). Yellow for money, paper for counts.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: Amounts in bar till rows, right-aligned, in yellow, tabular-nums. Whole Jamaican dollars, no cents (formatJmd). Replaces the old fixed-width font.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Independent reggae and dancehall. We sign artists, not sounds.
styles.usage: The line under a hero or headline. 16px inside the home hero. Black on yellow, paper on black or red.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We sign artists, not sounds. If the music is rooted, honest and built to last, we want to hear it.
styles.usage: Anything read at length, best on paper. Sentence case, under 66 characters a line.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: You keep your publishing. We handle the platform.
styles.usage: Form inputs, table cells, card bodies, the page default.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Uppercase. Button labels only, inside a 46px square button. Short words.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Tags (release type, 'Walk-in welcome'), the phone Menu button, 'more' links under a grid. Replaces the old eyebrow; never above a headline.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Navigation, table headings (muted), meta lines, footer. Field labels use the same weight at 14px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The tiny line under a tile name, status chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gaps: tag padding, the gap between a title and its bar.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap in tile, card and button rows (the tight pasted-wall grid).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tile and release-card inner padding; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; default padding inside small blocks and studio panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding (18 to 20px); padding of section samples.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gutter from 640px up; padding inside home and Lounge blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero copy padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between a lead and its button on heroes.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between stacked blocks inside one section.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on phones; cover headline top padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Largest step: space at the end of a long page.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every button, field, card, tile, tag and photo. The brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only the dark see-through circle behind the logo on a photo, the speaker rings and the grille holes. Never a card, button or solid logo circle.

border.note: Edge widths. Edges are solid; no shadows.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: line dividers on black: table rows, studio card edges.

tokens.name: border-field
tokens.usage: Fields on paper (black, 18.2:1), the inner yellow edge of the outlined button, plain tags, Lounge list rules.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: The black rule dividing a release card; the dashed yellow edge of an empty-state panel.

tokens.name: border-band
tokens.usage: The yellow line under the site header and between a Lounge block's text and photo.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width on every interactive element: red on paper, yellow on black, black on yellow, paper on red.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline (3px on the public site's large buttons).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, centred (Tailwind max-w-6xl).

tokens.name: read-max
tokens.usage: Line length for long reading on paper.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: gutter-wide
tokens.usage: Side gutter from 640px up.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of every button and field. Square corners.

tokens.name: section-bar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the thick red bar under a section title (64px inside the home page).

tokens.name: section-bar-height
tokens.usage: Thickness of the red bar under a section title (7px inside the home page).

tokens.name: grille-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between speaker-grille holes, across and down.

tokens.name: grille-hole
tokens.usage: Diameter of one grille hole (big holes only).

tokens.name: grille-band
tokens.usage: Width of the grille band beside the home hero photo; 40 to 46px tall when it runs across a phone layout or a story.

tokens.name: grille-band-wide
tokens.usage: Width of the grille band on a cover or poster-size block.

tokens.name: corner-block
tokens.usage: Side of the square corner block holding the flame on a photo or card (78px on posts).

tokens.name: rings-hero
tokens.usage: Speaker rings around the flame on a hero photo or cover.

tokens.name: rings-post
tokens.usage: Speaker rings on the home photo and social posts (118 to 132px).

tokens.name: logo-min
tokens.usage: Smallest height of any logo file.

tokens.name: story-safe-top
tokens.usage: Keep text out of the top of a 1080 by 1920 story.

tokens.name: story-safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Keep text out of the bottom of a 1080 by 1920 story.
